## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks, raw data and frequency stability

B1–B2 is the only wired voltage pair. The following reloads the native TSVs, plots signed Rxx and leakage first, then onset tracks and FFTs (linear R, detrended in B; no absolute-value/log distortion). Both runs completed without clipping: run 6 peaks at 530 Ω and run 7 at 587 Ω on 5 kΩ full scale; current stays 9.81–9.94 nA. The plotted gate-current excursions remain below the established 1 nA trip.

## Spot-check verdict and fan design gate

Run 6 (n=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻², calibrated D≈0) has peaks near 7.3, 14.8, 22.3 and 29.4 T. Their near-integer relationships are a harmonic/multiple-region confound, not four proven Fermi surfaces. Across B-window/detrender choices the ~7/15/22/30 T structure persists, while the lowest-frequency background changes. Run 7 (n=−1.2×10¹²) has clearer oscillations and an onset of 0.714 T, but the **computed full model**, not the old spot-proposal estimates, predicts ABAB 5.863/6.545 T there: their 0.682 T separation is below 2δF=1.54 T even with Bmax=10 T. A hole fan cannot cleanly count that pair at this onset. This corrects the approximate 5.3/7.1 T values in measure cell 41.

The electron side is therefore the feasible fan side despite its weaker signal: model at +3.2 predicts 7.306/25.783 T versus ABCA F_L=33.085 T. Electron onset from the default helper is spuriously censored at the coarse low-field record edge; those 50 mT samples fail Nyquist on F_L below 1 T. Restricting to B≥1 T still returns a censored 7.3 T track. Per `landau-fan`'s binding cost-floor gate, acquire one short fine low-field extension at the same density before choosing B_lo. This is in-arc `sdh-spot-check`, and prevents pricing a long fan on an aliased onset. No stacking verdict yet; the run-5 parallel CNP ridge, geometry-prior density scale, harmonics and possible adjacent-N alternatives remain live confounds.

## HERA — resolve electron onset before the Landau fan

> **05:22** · Electron onset: n=+3.2e12 D=0, B 0.3->1.5 T, 268 uniform-1/B points, sr1 50 uV, base T · **ETA ~05:52** (≈30 min)

`sdh-spot-check`, governing `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 3 and `landau-fan` cost-floor gate. Runs 6–7 and their raw/FFT analysis are in ana: the hole signal is stronger but its model pair is unresolvable; the electron onset is censored, and run 6's sub-1 T 50 mT grid aliases the 33.1 T reference. Repeat only 0.3–1.5 T at n=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D≈0 with 268 uniform-1/B points (Δ1/B=0.00999 T⁻¹, >3 samples/F_L period), then choose the electron fan's B floor from the combined record. Keep 50 µV sensitivity for direct comparison, 0.3 s/24 dB lock-in settings and ≥3 s driver settle; record/plot temperatures, both gate currents and both wired lock-ins X/P.

The handoff left B≈0 and gates at zero. Preconditions re-read validators, thermometry freshness, heaters off, drive, Si, contact binding and pacing before any write. Price: total upward traverse 1.5/0.137=10.95 min plus 268×3.4 s≈15.2 min (run 6 wall 7218 s minus its 73 min bare traverse gives ≈3.1 s/point; allow extra temperature read/overhead), plus gate ramp/settle. Check first 20 points for clipping/leakage and at completion for onset; the existing 1 nA gate-current trip remains. Ends at 1.5 T and the spot gates; no temperature or Si move.

# Read-only preconditions: no changes to validators, limits, ramp pacing or heaters.
import numpy as np
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
for _param,_expected in [(k_tg.volt,(-0.3,1.0)),(k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.0)),
    (dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)),(dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),
    (magnet.field,(-10.,10.)),(heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),(heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
    _actual=(float(_param.vals._min_value),float(_param.vals._max_value))
    print(_param.full_name,'validator expected',_expected,'actual',_actual)
    assert _actual==_expected
assert B_SESSION_CAP==10 and T_SESSION_CAP==100
for _name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(_name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
_Ts,_Tv=T_sample(),T_vaporizer()
_B=magnet.field(); _Si=k_si()
_ranges=(heater.sample_range(),heater.vaporizer_range())
print('Expected base sample 1.0-1.5 K, vaporizer <1.6 K within 0.6 K; actual',_Ts,_Tv)
print('Expected heaters (0,0), Si 0 V; actual',_ranges,_Si)
assert 1.0<=_Ts<=1.5 and _Tv<1.6 and abs(_Tv-_Ts)<0.6
assert _ranges==(0,0) and abs(_Si)<.01
_ps,_out=magnet.persistent_switch_on(),magnet.output_enabled()
print('Expected PS/output True/True; actual',_ps,_out); assert _ps and _out
print('Expected drive 1 V/13.777 Hz; actual',sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency())
assert abs(sr1.amplitude()-1)<.001 and abs(sr1.frequency()-13.777)<.001
for _sr in (sr0,sr1):
    _tau,_slope=_sr.time_constant(),_sr.filter_slope()
    print(_sr.name,'expected tau 0.3 s slope 24 dB; actual',_tau,_slope)
    assert abs(_tau-.3)<1e-9 and _slope==24
assert WIRING=={'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2','sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
assert k_tg is k_2400_tg and k_bg is k_2400_bg and k_si is dc205.smart_voltage
print('Gate pacing expected 0.005 V steps, Si 0.5 V/s; actual',k_tg.volt.step,k_bg.volt.step,dc205.ramp_rate)
assert k_tg.volt.step==.005 and k_bg.volt.step==.005 and dc205.ramp_rate==.5
print('Expected DC205 RNGE 2/output 1; actual',dc205.voltage_range(),dc205.output())
assert dc205.voltage_range()==2 and dc205.output()==1
CAL=dict(c_tg=2.796e-3,c_bg=2.161e-3,n_offset=-.0894,D_offset=-.013)
print('Expected initial B near 0 T after handoff; actual',_B); assert abs(_B)<.05
assert magnet.settle_s>=3.0
Vtg,Vbg=calc_gate_voltages(3.2,0.,**CAL)
B_vec=1/np.linspace(1/.3,1/1.5,268)
assert np.max(np.abs(np.diff(1/B_vec)))<=1/(3*33.086)
for p,v in [(k_tg.volt,Vtg),(k_bg.volt,Vbg)]: p.validate(float(v))
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
mc=dict(meas_config);mc.update({'sample_temperature:':_Ts,'Si (V)':_Si,'comments':'onset extension; n=+3.2e12 D=0, uniform 1/B .3->1.5 T; same 50uV sensitivity as run6'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment('Electron onset extension: n=+3.2e12 cm^-2 D=0, run5 CAL; B 0.3->1.5 T 268 uniform-1/B points; sr1 50uV, 10nA, 3s magnet settle; TG/BG 1nA trip')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(Vbg));s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(Vtg));interruptible_sleep(10)
follow=[T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P]
for p in follow: s.fp(p);s.plot('time',p)
def extension_guard(station,data):
    vals=dict(zip([p.full_name for p in follow],data[2:]))
    if abs(vals[k_tg.curr.full_name])>1e-9 or abs(vals[k_bg.curr.full_name])>1e-9 or not 1.0<=vals[T_sample.full_name]<=1.5:
        print('STOP extension: gate current or sample T outside precondition',vals)
        station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(extension_guard,())
s.sweep(magnet.field,B_vec,delay=0)
print('Extension end actual B/TG/BG:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt())

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).

# === SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0 (region-A calibration), B 0 -> 10 T ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: sweep starts at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in B (blocking rate-limited magnet). 50 mT to 1 T (background only), 10 mT 1 -> 10 T:
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((np.arange(0.0, 1.0, 0.05), np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.01))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm full scale at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 70 Ohm = 1.4 % FS; MR + SdH maxima at high B size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0 -> 10 T, 10 mT above 1 T, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0 -> 10 T uniform-B (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field stays at 10 T (the hole-side spot check rides it down) — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")

## HERA — Step 3b: SdH spot check, hole side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = −1.2×10¹² at D = 0, riding the magnet 10 → 0.3 T

> **03:34** · sdh-spot-check h-side: n=-1.2e12 D=0 (Vtg -0.280, Vbg -0.463), B 10->0.3 T, 20 mT, delay 0, sr1 50 uV; ends at 0.3 T · **ETA ~05:19** (≈1h45m)

Feasibility (model): F_L = 12.4 T; ABAB pair ≈ 5.3 / 7.1 T (the near-CNP semimetal regime, tones close and balanced — the recipe's stated low-|n| exception), ABCA 12.4 T with m* ≈ 1 mₑ — LK-dead at this rig's T_e ≈ 8 K. **Coverage trade, stated:** this is a cheap preview, not a decisive read — it costs ~35 min over the bare 10 → 0 T ramp the session needs anyway, and a null here is resolvability-limited, not evidence.
